reasoning: Duplicate of F0229; same conclusion. TagFixWallGranPackExchange (fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:368-373) uses 'const int i = d_sendlist(mysend); int m = i*size_history;' -- a local-atom-index offset -- while pack_exchange_kokkos returns nsend*size_history (:410) and comm_kokkos.cpp:1404 MPI_Sends exactly that many leading doubles of k_buf_send, whose capacity is only grown to nsend*maxexchange (comm_kokkos.cpp:1371-1372). The reference implementations index by the send slot (fix_neigh_history_kokkos.cpp:383-385, fix_spring_self_kokkos.cpp:186-187). Nothing elsewhere compensates.
fix: Use 'int m = mysend*size_history;' for the buffer offset, keeping i = d_sendlist(mysend) for the d_history_one reads and the copylist compaction.

reasoning: Duplicate of F0230; same conclusion. fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:420-425 computes 'int index = d_indices(i)', uses it only as a >-1 guard, and stores into 'd_history_one(i,v)'. Siblings store at the mapped index (fix_spring_self_kokkos.cpp:260-262 'd_xoriginal(index,0) = ...', fix_neigh_history_kokkos.cpp:467-471 'd_npartner(index) = n'). d_indices comes from AtomVecKokkos::unpack_exchange_kokkos (comm_kokkos.cpp:1358-1360) and is the local slot the received atom landed in, generally != i.
fix: Store into d_history_one(index,v) instead of d_history_one(i,v).

reasoning: Duplicate of F0231; same conclusion, same adjustment. The pairstyle chain (fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:107-119) has no branch for GRANULAR, which FixWallGranOld's constructor accepts (fix_wall_gran_old.cpp:83) and which is enumerator 3 of the inherited enum (fix_wall_gran_old.h:29), so 'fix ... wall/gran granular ...' with -sf kk runs with zero wall force and no error. ADJUSTMENT: the 'region' half is not a port defect -- FixWallGranOld::post_force has no REGION branch either (fix_wall_gran_old.cpp:645-677), so the CPU class this style derives from is equally unusable for wallstyle REGION (it would leave rsq=0 and divide by r=0); the KOKKOS behaviour merely differs in how it is broken.
fix: Add a trailing 'else error->all(FLERR, "Fix wall/gran/kk does not yet support the granular interaction style");' to the pairstyle chain and an equivalent guard for unsupported wallstyle values, preferably hoisted into FixWallGranKokkos::init().

reasoning: Verified both halves. fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:105 sets 'copymode = 1;' and the two error->all() calls at :108 and :119 sit between it and the 'copymode = 0;' at :123, and Error::all unconditionally throws (src/error.cpp:83 'throw LAMMPSException(mesg);'), so it does not necessarily terminate the process. Both destructors bail on copymode: fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:50-55 'if (copymode) return;' and fix_wall_gran_old.cpp:475-490 'if (copymode) return; atom->delete_callback(id,Atom::GROW); atom->delete_callback(id,Atom::RESTART); ...'. So in an embedded/Python use that catches the exception and then deletes the fix, the Atom GROW/RESTART callbacks stay registered on a freed object. The path is reachable: 'hooke' and 'hertz/history' are accepted by the constructor (fix_wall_gran_old.cpp:81-82). ADJUSTMENT to severity: with the standard lmp executable the exception aborts the run, so the dangling-callback failure needs the library/Python interface plus a caller that continues after the error -- latent rather than routinely hit.
fix: Move both unsupported-style error->all() checks out of the copymode region -- best into FixWallGranKokkos::init(), since pairstyle is fixed at construction; failing that, place them before 'copymode = 1;' in post_force.
